A study on the analysis of dr ug inter action in pr escr iptions of car diac clinic by PASS LAI Wei - hua，LIAO Guang - ren，LUO Yu - fen. (Guangdong Provincial People′s Hospital, Guangzhou 510080, China)Abstr act: Objective To investigate and analyze the drug interaction in prescription and evaluate the efficiency of PASS in our hospital. Methods Prescriptions of cardiac clinic were randomly sampled and retrospectively analyzed by PASS. Results 1258 times drug interaction appeared in 637 prescriptions, including 136 in serious, 930 in moderate and 192 in mild; the percentage of drug interaction had a direct relationship with the kinds of medicine. Conclusion It is necessary for our hospital to improve the rational usage of medicine.Key wor ds： Prescription Automatic Screening system; drug interaction; retrospective analysis; clinic prescriptions合理用药监测系统 (Prescription AutomaticScreening System，PASS)是由四川美康医药软件公司开发的，由国家药典委员会和国家药品监督管理局药品评价中心联合监制的，供医生和药师进行合理用药监测、药品信息查询的计算机医药应用软件系统。药物相互作用审查是其核心功能之一。本文利用PASS药物相互作用审查功能对本院心内科门诊处方进行回顾性监测分析，以了解我院心内科门诊处方中出现的药物相互作用情况，为临床合理用药提供参考，同时对 PASS系统的性能进行评估。
